run.question:
Alertmanager alert CheckoutPlaceOrderErrorRatioHigh (severity critical) is firing for service otel-demo/checkout since 2026-11-17T02:29:54Z.
Alert expression (PromQL): label_replace(label_replace((sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[5m]))) / (sum by (k8s_namespace_name, service_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{k8s_namespace_name="otel-demo",service_name="checkout",span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER",span_name=~".*CheckoutService/PlaceOrder"}[5m]))), "namespace", "$1", "k8s_namespace_name", "(.*)"), "service", "$1", "service_name", "(.*)") > 0.5
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The alert is reproduced: checkout's oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server-span error ratio evaluated to 1 at 02:27:54Z, 02:28:54Z and 02:29:54Z (0 earlier in the hour). The failures are charge failures: each sampled failed PlaceOrder span wraps the payment error 'rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' (rpc.grpc.status_code=13), and the only checkout operation with error status in the last 10 minutes was its client call oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge. The error is raised inside the payment service itself - payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is error=true with the stacktrace 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) ... at async Object.chargeServiceHandler (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)' - so the origin of the failing responses is the otel-demo/payment Deployment, while checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy and load-generator are carriers/propagators of that error. The operator-noted checkout rollout at 02:15:21Z (release rel-20261117021521) is real and configuration-only (new ReplicaSet checkout-86bc54d9b7, identical image digest sha256:5ab0d7b9...), but the same payment 'Invalid token' failure signature and identical checkout wrapping already occurred at 01:37:44Z-01:39:06Z, while checkout was still on checkout-6cf48b76d7, and PlaceOrder still succeeded after the new pod appeared; the payment pod and image were unchanged all hour. What actually flipped payment into rejecting charges near 02:25Z is not observable with the available integrations (no change history, no pod logs, no flag/ConfigMap state).

claims.text: The alert expression's own ratio is reproduced: the checkout CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server-span error ratio evaluated to exactly 1 at 02:27:54Z, 02:28:54Z and 02:29:54Z, was 0 at every evaluated point from 01:49:54Z to 02:25:54Z, and was NaN at 02:26:54Z (zero denominator).

In the 10 minutes ending 02:29:54Z the only checkout span operation carrying STATUS_CODE_ERROR was its client call oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (increase() 6.0228 for ERROR plus 3.3333 for UNSET); checkout's other operations (oteldemo.CartService/GetCart 10, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart 3.33, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert 35.56, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 25.56, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 10, oteldemo.ShippingService/ShipOrder 3.33, HTTP POST 3.33, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart 10) had no error series.

Sampled checkout traces (02:26:31Z-02:29:24Z) show every failed oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder server span with otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and its child client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and rpc.grpc.status_code=2.

The failing response originates inside the otel-demo payment service: payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR and exception stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) ... at async Object.chargeServiceHandler (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)'.

payment's grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server-spans show STATUS_CODE_ERROR rate 0 through 02:24:54Z, then 0.0125 at 02:26:54Z and 0.02083 at 02:28:54Z, with STATUS_CODE_UNSET falling to 0 at those last two points.

An earlier burst of the identical failure pattern preceded the current one: payment Charge error rate was 0.04167 at 01:34:54Z and 0.0125-0.0333 at the points up to 01:42:54Z, then 0 at 01:44:54Z, and sampled payment traces from 01:37:44Z-01:39:06Z show the same 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' exception at charge.js:37:13 and the same checkout 13 INTERNAL wrapping.

The checkout Deployment was rolled out configuration-only inside the window: pod checkout-6cf48b76d7-w7v8n (ReplicaSet checkout-6cf48b76d7) is last seen at 02:13:54Z and pod checkout-86bc54d9b7-zwcw8 (ReplicaSet checkout-86bc54d9b7) first appears at 02:15:54Z, while both pods report the same image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635 (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-checkout).

The payment Deployment did not change during the window: pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 under ReplicaSet payment-6f7bc865d6 is present for every sample from 01:29:54Z to 02:29:54Z with the same image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87, and no second payment ReplicaSet or pod appears.
Both deployments stayed available: kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready was 1 for deployment checkout and for deployment payment at every sampled point from 01:29:54Z through 02:29:54Z.

No pod or ReplicaSet change occurred for flagd (flagd-d6485586b-xskfj), frontend (frontend-6c9bc688bf-k5xtz), frontend-proxy (frontend-proxy-844799bcdb-g7dwm) or load-generator (load-generator-5ff476786d-sw2kh) during 01:29:54Z-02:29:54Z.

Other entities carry their own observed error spans in the same failing traces: frontend (POST http.status_code=500, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' error=true, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder error=true rpc.grpc.status_code=13), frontend-proxy (ingress and router frontend egress http.status_code 500, error=true) and load-generator (POST http.status_code 500, error=true); their error-span increase() over the 10 minutes ending 02:29:54Z was frontend 20, frontend-proxy 13.3333 and load-generator 6.6667.

checkout's other dependencies returned success in the sampled failing traces and in the last 10 minutes: currency Currency/Convert rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with otel.status_code=OK, shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and POST http.status_code=200, cart oteldemo.CartService/GetCart rpc.grpc.status_code=0, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct rpc.grpc.status_code=0, quote POST /getquote; ad and flagd each reported a 0 error-span increase over that 10 minutes.

recommendation is not tracking this incident: its error-span increase() is a constant 1.1111 in every one of the six 10-minute buckets from 01:39:54Z to 02:29:54Z, including the long interval when checkout and payment had zero error spans.

A plausible trigger for payment's 'Invalid token' rejections is a runtime flag/configuration value consumed inside payment's charge path: payment emits client spans grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat as a child of its charge work (present in the failing trace and in the 02:29:54Z bucket, absent in most other 10-minute buckets), while its pod, image and ReplicaSet stayed unchanged. This is unverified: flagd itself reported 0 error spans and no pod change, and no flag values are observable with the available integrations.

A request-content cause cannot be ruled out from the available data: the rejection is a token validation decision inside payment, but span payloads do not expose the charge request/card token, so it is unknown whether the token sent by checkout changed. Countervailing observations are that the load-generator pod was unchanged and that the identical rejection appeared in the earlier 01:37-01:39 burst.

The 02:15:21Z configuration-only checkout rollout (rel-20261117021521) did not introduce this failure mode: the identical payment 'Invalid token' exception and identical checkout 13 INTERNAL wrapping were already present at 01:37:44Z-01:39:06Z while checkout ran on ReplicaSet checkout-6cf48b76d7; after the new pod appeared at 02:15:54Z, sampled PlaceOrder spans still returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 (02:16:32Z, 02:18:42Z, 02:18:52Z, 02:21:41Z, 02:21:56Z, 02:22:17Z) and the first sampled error span is 02:26:31Z; and the component that performs the rejection (payment) kept the same pod and image digest throughout.

Payment unavailability/restart is not the cause: deployment payment reported 1 ready replica at every sampled point, the same pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 and image digest served the whole hour, and the failing server spans completed quickly (0.65-3.82 ms) with an application-level error rather than failing to serve.

gaps: The trigger that flipped payment into rejecting charges near 02:25Z is not observable: change_history and pod_logs are listed as not_integrated, and no ConfigMap, feature-flag or flagd flag state is exposed, so neither the flagd flag values consumed by payment nor the checkout configuration content of rel-20261117021521 could be inspected.

Span payloads are not exposed, so the actual card token / charge request fields that payment judged 'Invalid token' are unknown; it is therefore unverified whether the rejected requests differed from the ones that succeeded before 02:25Z.
Whether the failure is still ongoing after 02:29:54Z is unknown; the last evaluated point of the alert expression is 02:29:54Z.

Trace evidence is a biased sample, not a complete call graph or a failure rate: the checkout traces_search kept 1434 spans and the read slice returned 100 (omitted_rows 1334), and the payment traces_search kept 202 spans with 142 omitted; omitted spans and their attributions remain unknown, and span counts are not unique request counts.

The earlier burst is only partially covered: it was already in progress at the first evaluated point (01:34:54Z) and its start time, end time and per-request cause are unknown; only traces from 01:37:44Z-01:39:06Z were sampled.

The constant recommendation error-span signal (1.1111 per 10 minutes all hour) was not investigated; its error content and whether it is a pre-existing unrelated issue is unknown, and it is not tied to this incident by evidence.

No logs, kube events or change records were available for the ingress/router layer, so the frontend/frontend-proxy 500s are attributed only via their own sampled error spans carrying the checkout/payment error text.
next_steps: Inspect the flagd flag configuration and its change history for payment-related flags (the value payment reads through grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat in the charge path), focusing on changes near 02:25Z and 01:34Z; correlate with payment's ResolveFloat spans.

Compare the environment/config of ReplicaSet checkout-86bc54d9b7 (rel-20261117021521) with checkout-6cf48b76d7 - including any baggage such as app.loyalty.level that appears inside the payment error text - to definitively include or exclude the configuration change.
Read payment pod logs around 02:25-02:30Z to capture the charge request fields and the validation branch taken at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37, and compare with the 01:37-01:39 burst.
Continue monitoring checkout's PlaceOrder error ratio and payment's Charge error rate past 02:30Z to confirm whether the condition persists or self-clears, as the earlier burst did.
